assumptions.session: 09:45 <= entry < 15:45 America/New_York; flatten at last observed price at cutoff
assumptions.entry: After an observed overshoot, second progressive one-band reversal event; new extreme/DC resets count; next observed raw tick fill, without waiting for a bounce; one attempt per excursion
assumptions.band_definition: BandSize from authoritative ITI replay, 20% of primary threshold; freeze entry-signal BandSize
assumptions.stop: Freeze 4 entry bands from actual fill; round distance inward to an ES quarter point; exit first touching/crossing raw price, retaining gaps
assumptions.profit_exit: Trailing watermark only, plus session flatten
assumptions.watermark_rule: Activate only after signed profit >2 entry bands; floor ratchets to each whole-band gain, never retreats; exit first raw price strictly below signed floor, retaining gap price
assumptions.costs: Gross trade-price proxies; no commissions, quote spread, slippage model or latency
assumptions.comparison: Only entry side differs; each policy owns its own position lifecycle, so subsequent entries may diverge
assumptions.loss_definition: Any realized negative gross trade counts; halt new entries after 1 loss(es) on that New York trading date; resume next trading date; winners do not reset count
